name: Structured Remittance Information 6
definition: Structured information supplied to enable the matching, i.e. reconciliation, of a payment with the items that the payment is intended to settle, eg, commercial invoices in an accounts receivable system.

ReferredDocumentInformation.name: Referred Document Information
ReferredDocumentInformation.definition: Reference information to allow the identification of the underlying reference documents.

ReferredDocumentRelatedDate.name: Referred Document Related Date
ReferredDocumentRelatedDate.definition: Date associated with the referred document, eg, date of issue.

ReferredDocumentAmount.name: Referred Document Amount
ReferredDocumentAmount.definition: Amount of money and currency of a document referred to in the remittance section. The amount is typically either the original amount due and payable, or the amount actually remitted for the referred document.

CreditorReferenceInformation.name: Creditor Reference Information
CreditorReferenceInformation.definition: Reference information provided by the creditor to allow the identification of the underlying documents.

Invoicer.name: Invoicer
Invoicer.definition: Identification of the organization issuing the invoice when different than the creditor or final party.

Invoicee.name: Invoicee
Invoicee.definition: Identification of the party to whom an invoice is issued, when different than the originator or debtor.

AdditionalRemittanceInformation.name: Additional Remittance Information
AdditionalRemittanceInformation.definition: Additional information, in free text form, to complement the structured remittance information.
